Distribution. Goyder Formation, Amadeus Basin, Northern Territory; Spurs Formation, Northern Victoria Land, Antarctica. All occurrences are Cambrian Series 3, Guzhangian (Mindyallan) in age.

Distribution. All specimens were collected in southern India, in Karnataka State (known before 1973 as State of Mysore), predominantly in its southern part: in Kushalanagara (previously known as Fraserpet) and Bilukoppa (= Bylakuppe) in Kodagu district (previously known as Coorg); one specimen was collected near Dandeli, Uttara Kannada district, northern Karnataka.
Distribution. Australia: Western Australia, Northern Territory.

Distribution in Iran. Golestan (Hoberlandt 1997), Tehran (Wagner 1968; Hoberlandt 1997), Iran (no locality cited) (Göllner-Scheiding 2006 b). General distribution. Near East (Sinai), Caucasus and Central Asia.
Distribution in the Arabian Peninsula: Saudi Arabia (Linsenmaier 1994 as Chrysis (Chrysis) aeneiventris). Extralimital distribution: No records.

Distribution. Trinomys minor is endemic to the Cerrado and the Caatinga (not Carmignotto et al. 2012, Paglia et al. 2012), and has been recorded in the Brazilian state of Bahia (Pessoa et al. 2015 b).
Distribution in India. Uttarakhand (Pithoragarh District). General Distribution. India.
